notes.title: Karate Survivor is out now!
notes.content:
Are you ready to unleash your inner martial arts master? Karate Survivor is live, ready to throw you into the gritty, fast-paced world of 80s street brawls! 

In this survivor-like roguelite, every corner of the city is your battleground. Fend off relentless thugs using fists, feet, and anything you can get your hands on – from mop handles to plastic flamingos! Your surroundings are part of your arsenal. Push over scaffolding, swing microwave doors, and turn the world into a weapon. 

[previewyoutube=WH_KjiLuvMg;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]What awaits you in Karate Survivor: [/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Improvised Combat:[/b] Use whatever you can get your hands on to dismantle your enemies. Even a toy hammer can be lethal! 
[*][b] Environmental Warfare: [/b]Manipulate the streets to your advantage. Push objects at enemies, bring down scaffolding, or slam them with a microwave door. 
[*] [b]Dynamic Combos: [/b]Mix and match dozens of attacks into unique six-move combos. Find the most devastating combos to suit your style. 
[*] [b]Progression and Mastery: [/b]Unlock and master techniques that stay with you across runs. Every fight brings you closer to martial arts mastery. 
[*] [b]Fast-paced Runs and Boss Battles: [/b]Face fierce bosses across gritty locations in epic, high-speed showdowns. 
[/list]
Also, we’ll be adding a new challenge mode as a New Game+ with increased difficulty in an upcoming post-release patch for those eager to test their skills. 

Stay tuned and grab Karate Survivor now with a 10% launch discount. Don’t forget to leave a review to support us!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3027930/Karate_Survivor/

notes.title: Technotopia is Now Available!
notes.content:
[b]Technotopia, a game developed by Yustas and published by Alawar, is now available on Windows and macOS![/b] The city of the future awaits, and it’s your time to take control. 

As the AI Iris, you are tasked with creating the perfect city in a world fractured by social and economic unrest. The metropolis teeters on the edge of chaos, and the balance between competing factions is fragile. Every decision you make will shape the fate of Technotopia – will you build a utopia, or let the city descend into turmoil? 

[previewyoutube=8ZPQsLAHWfg;full][/previewyoutube]

What awaits you in Technotopia: 

[list]
[*] 4 Faction-Driven Questlines: Capitalists, aristocrats, politicians, and common citizens all want control of the city. Navigate their conflicting agendas and choose your allies wisely – each storyline will alter the city’s future. 
[*] 100+ Unique Buildings: Construct skyscrapers, parks, residential zones, and industrial hubs. Every building you place will influence the balance of power, helping or hindering different factions. Strategically combine city blocks to maximize efficiency and unlock special bonuses. 
[*] 50+ Dynamic Events: From everyday mishaps to faction conflicts, every event in Technotopia is shaped by your choices, with consequences that ripple across the city. 
[*] Factions' Influence: Every decision shifts the delicate balance between the city’s ruling groups. Will you appease the elites, or side with the people? 
[*] City News & Criminal Activity: As crime rises, new challenges emerge, forcing you to make tough decisions. Stay informed through real-time news reports that reflect the impact of your actions on the city's order. 
[/list]
Get the game with a [b]10% launch[/b] discount and share your feedback on Technotopia – we’re excited to hear your thoughts! Join our Discord to stay up to date on the latest news. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2825110/Technotopia/

notes.title: Necroking is now available!
notes.content:
Necroking has officially emerged from the shadows and is now live on Windows and macOS! 

The world is crumbling under chaos. Cities are rotting and the living dare to stand in your way. But fear not, because you are the Necroking – master of the undead, wielder of dark magic, and bringer of doom. It’s time to raise your army and show the world what real power looks like! 

[previewyoutube=mZ1W5iGz0MU;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What awaits you in Necroking:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Become the Death Monarch.[/b] Command over 30 unique undead minions and crush anyone who stands against you. 
[*] [b]Vast Skull Deckbuilding. [/b]Customize your deck, unlock powerful unites, and devastate your enemies. 
[*] [b]4 diverse biomes.[/b] Each with its own deadly challenges and unique bosses. 
[*] [b]King’s Secret. [/b]Unravel the mystery of the King as you journey through a dark, twisted story. 
[/list]
You can already play Necroking on Steam Deck using the trackpads, and we’re hard at work on adding full controller and Steam Deck support in upcoming updates. Stay tuned and join our [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url] server to keep up with all the news!

Get the game with a 10% launch discount and leave feedback on Necroking – we can’t wait to hear what you think:

notes.title: Necrosmith 2, a new game by Alawar, is out now!

Necrosmith 2 is now available on Windows and MacOS ☠️

Return to the world of the necromancy! This time, raise your undead against dreadful monsters, utilizing the newest features to create titans and control them to lead your army to victory. They await your command to begin the battle!

[previewyoutube=hG318ckoFgo;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] Assemble your army from diverse body parts, each imbued with unique abilities that allow you to overcome obstacles, whether they are towering mountains, flowing rivers, or lakes of red-hot lava.

notes.title: Healing Issues Update & Major Changes
notes.content:
Hey, wall diggers! We've prepared a major update that includes many bug fixes and several major changes. Please make sure that you have the latest (1.2.4.482) version of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/a9a6969551236b718fb3dceb35d045a303d6214a.jpg[/img]

First things first, the '[b]Dying Changes Everything'[/b] achievement is now available even if you met its conditions earlier, before the DLC achievements were added to the game.

[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced the Pulse Gun relic damage.
[*] Reduced the drones' rocket damage.
[*] Changed the attacking priority for the drones and the spider's rockets. They now target the most dangerous zyrex first and the weakest ones last.
[*] Changed the layer of the circular drone's spawn from the layer under the character to the layer under the robospider.
[*] Added a warning sign that appears on the player's robospider when the Zeus (white robospider) launches the homing rocket.
[*] Fixed an issue when the repair kit didn't heal the character.
[*] Fixed an issue when the robospider didn’t take any damage after the first dash to the Leviathan's tentacle until the next dash.
[*] Fixed an issue when the player didn’t take any damage from the Leviathan's laser.
[*] Fixed an issue when the robospider got stuck in the enemies' dying animation and couldn't move forward until the melee enemies disappeared off the screen.
[*] Fixed an issue when the talent 'Rare Resources' brought the resources from the DLC to the base game.
[*] Fixed an issue when the circular drone kept attacking the areas on the wall where the Boulder was located before it was destroyed.
[*] Fixed an issue when the rocket stopped working after players bought its 5th grade in the meta-shop.
[*] Fixed a visual issue when the animation of Leviathan's death displayed incorrectly and had the wrong size.
[*] Fixed a visual issue when the energy shield was not visible against the cloud background.
[/list]
Thank you for your feedback and support in helping us make Wall World better. Stay tuned and enjoy the game 💙

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474860/Wall_World_Deep_Threat

notes.title: Wall World: Deep Threat is now available!
notes.content:
Wall diggers, are you ready to take your Wall World experience to the next level? Look no further! Introducing an epic Wall World: Deep Threat DLC, where unexplored realms call and ancient enigmas of the Wall await your discovery. 

The Wall World: Deep Threat is a story expansion DLC that brings plenty of new content to the in-game world. It contains 9 new biomes, 4 tiers that provide clues about what’s happened with the Wall. Additionally, there are more menacing Zyrex variations and fiercer bosses, undiscovered relics and blueprints previously unseen, along with new powerful guns, useful equipment, and abilities. 

[b]Watch Wall World: Deep Threat launch trailer now:[/b]
[previewyoutube=nWmDrSt1kYA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What’s more? [/b]
[list]
[*] Deep Threat will work with your current saves. You don’t need to finish the game or start a new one to play the new content. The DLC is compatible with your ongoing Wall World journey! 
[*] The Wall World soundtrack is amplified with 6 more new tracks from the DLC. If you are a happy owner of the soundtrack for the main game, it will be automatically updated to the expanded version. 
[*] Achievements for Wall World: Deep Threat will be available later, after the DLC is released. 
[/list]

 The DLC launches with a 10% discount, which will be active until August 16th: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474860/Wall_World_Deep_Threat 

We also have the perfect [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31629/]Wall World Complete[/url] bundle for true wall diggers, which includes the base game, Deep Threat DLC & soundtrack. 

 See you on the Wall, diggers! 

Don’t forget to follow our official channels to stay up-to-date on all things Wall World:  
[url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/alawarteam]Twitter[/url] 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/AlawarPremium]Steam[/url]

notes.title: The DLC is coming — pre-release patch 1.2.0.404
notes.content:
Our team is actively preparing for the Wall World: Deep Threat release, which is why we have made this update for the base game.

This update is mostly a technical patch, with its main purpose being to lay the foundation for the upcoming release because initially, the architecture of Wall World hadn’t been adapted for future DLCs.

Several planned improvements for the DLC will also be incorporated into the main game. Here are the details of these changes:

[list]
[*] Changed the balance for the seismic generator, induction amplifier, and bomb, making them more useful.
[*] Changed the animation for speeding up spider jump preparation.
[*] Increased the respawn time for portable devices.
[/list]

Don't miss the opportunity to get Wall World at the current price before we increase it tomorrow:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187290/Wall_World

notes.title: What to expect in the Deep Threat, upcoming DLC to Wall World
notes.content:
Hey wall diggers,

We are working like bees creating this DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187290/Wall_World/]Wall World[/url]. And we want to show some things we’ve already done. 

Wall World: Deep Threat will bring you new epic tiers and biomes, dangerous bosses, powerful weapons, helpful relics and upgrades, and even more secrets buried in the Wall. Prepare to drill really deep! 

Here is just a small piece of everything that awaits you in the Deep Threat DLC: 

[h3]Tiers[/h3] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/0f7dd57041295205047e6e79b70517a950591c6d.png[/img]
[h3]Enemies[/h3]
Among the new ones – a zyrex with ranged attacks, moving only by jumping:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/0773f9c4c84f3ec9fceb7b49383a8fd490bd5ddc.gif[/img]
[h3]Weapons[/h3]
One of them is the [b]Chemical Weapon[/b], which fires gas bombs in a ballistic trajectory. The bombs explode on impact with enemies and leave clouds of gas at the site of the explosions, causing minor damage to enemies:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/6f1750900d0e124125dc9a5f01464a13d1b9bce5.png[/img]
[h3]Meta Upgrades[/h3]
Take a look at [b]Jump in Place[/b]. With this upgrade, the player gains the ability for the spider to jump off the wall and fall to the same place, damaging nearby enemies: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/bcd74203d641bc8c2990e5a5bf4aba8c1dee2819.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/45adfc59ebe1e329bb27acc56f1a4eb4791742b6.gif[/img]
[h3]Biomes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/de1bd31a848eca796aeea90e3ac467fd1915cf48.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/a4f924c9b674a17f90c6af5d14e991f8208e7636.png[/img]
[h3]Bosses[/h3]
Regarding the bosses, all we can say is that you should be brave and well-armored, because their rage and power increase after each fight. 

One of the bosses you'll encounter is named Zeus. Despite both of you being pretty similar, don't underestimate their might:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/d9f15c4564559e8368fd4dfcaf67c530af2e9e8d.gif[/img]

We prefer to keep the rest of the content a secret until the DLC release. Let us know what you think about this stuff 💥 

And, of course, don’t forget to add Wall World: Deep Threat to your wishlist to stay tuned and not miss its release: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474860/Wall_World_Deep_Threat/

notes.title: Huge Update 1.0.8 – challenging modes, Steam Deck & important announcements
notes.content:
Get ready because the biggest update in Wall World history is coming your way! We've been tinkering away in the development lab, fueled by your incredible support and feedback. And folks, do we have some exciting stuff to share with you 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/c07af0c1a7985dac67c857420ba6243e160e8d27.png[/img]

First things first, we've unleashed two new difficulty modes: Hard and Insane. If you thought Wall World was a piece of cake, well, prepare to have your skills tested. Second things second, we've also thrown in an instant weapon selection wheel. No more fumbling around trying to find the right gun. It's quick, convenient, and perfect for crushing zyrex hordes!

Moreover, now Wall World’s got the full Steam Deck support – we’ve added outlines to the enemies, adjusted UI and font size.

[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a weapon selection wheel.
[*] Added a visual notification for the enemy waves arrival.
[*] Added a setting for outlining enemies and increasing the UI elements. Works best for Steam Deck users.
[*] Added Hard and Insane difficulty modes.
[*] Added Discord and Twitter buttons to the starting screen.
[*] Increased the chance of obtaining crypto keys.
[*] Increased the efficiency of the docking station.
[*] Decreased the upgrade cost for the docking station.
[*] Changed the icon of the enemy wave arrival bar.
[*] Changed the color of the gun sight for better contrast.
[*] Removed the possibility to use various symbols (!@$&) in profile names to prevent save files corruption.
[*] Fixed an issue with the game being incorrectly displayed on widescreen monitors.
[*] Fixed an issue with devices falling out of the spider during dashes.
[*] Fixed an issue with overdrive accidental activation by pressing “OK” after picking up the scheme.
[*] Fixed an issue with the gamepad controls causing a delay before the player could use the “vacuum” button right after pressing the “drill” button.
[*] Fixed an issue with turrets and drones shooting at non-existent enemies.
[*] Fixed an issue with turrets and drones “accumulating” shots during the pause and bursting bullets like a shotgun upon resuming the game.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with a remote boss attack, in which the boss’s spit didn’t reach the Wall but crashed on the spider.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with a gap on the Wall being visible to the player in the starting biome.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with backgrounds being visible to the player through gaps in the clouds.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with tooltips overlapping buttons in the permanent upgrades menu.
[*] Fixed several localization strings.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/c88c83bff4f7e3eb6e1f3e053337f6739a30d9c1.jpg[/img]
Hold on, hold on! We've got one more special thing: [b]a new story DLC for Wall World is on the horizon[/b]! Our team has already started working on it. We know you're hungry for more details, and don't worry, we'll reveal some information about the upcoming DLC soon. 

And the last thing, we'll be making a slight price adjustment to our game in the near future. We've put a lot of love and effort into it, and this will help us continue improving the game and bringing you even more incredible content. But guess what? You can take advantage of the Steam Summer Sale that is starting later this month and grab Wall World at the lowest price before we increase it.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187290/Wall_World/

Keep your vacuum cleaner ready and stay tuned by joining the [url=https://discord.gg/alawar]Discord server[/url] so you don't miss the official announcement and other exciting news 💙

Hello!
We have prepared a new Wall World update for you! Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.6) version of the game.

[*]Fixed an issue with drones not working correctly when they were shooting into nowhere.

If you encounter an error in the game, please fill out our [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1OPmydhADrLyrAhmehMx6EBPSsgdC45y-JI46c91cHDg/edit]bug report form[/url]. This will help us find and fix the problem faster. Thank you 💙

Hey climbers,

This is the second post-release update for Wall World which includes notable balance changes, bug fixes and other minor but still important improvements based on your feedback. Please make sure you have the latest (1.0.2) version of the game installed. Hope you’ll enjoy Wall World even more!

[*] Added a sound effect for torpedo explosions in mines.
[*] Added a sound effect for building turret replicators and firing.
[*] Changed the length of some biomes.
[*] Changed the core keys generation system.
[*] Changed the order of "wow locations” generation.
[*] Reduced prices in the upgrade shop in-game.
[*] Reduced the tiles HP in the coral and bismuth biomes.
[*] Reduced the number of “lore” rooms in fourth biomes.
[*] Reduced the number of giant sized mines.
[*] Made finding rare resources a bit easier.
[*] Made finding secret schematics easier.
[*] Fixed an issue with saving player progress and profile if the game crashes.
[*] Fixed an issue with turrets stucking after a boss attack.
[*] Fixed an issue with the cassette bomb triggering if the power field HP drops to 20%.
[*] Various minor fixes.
[/list]
Besides, we'd like you to be informed of our plans. Among other things, we’re working on controls remapping ability, widescreen monitors support, localization improvements for all languages, and even more improvements for Wall World.

notes.title: Wall World Demo is here
notes.content:
Walldiggers, 

Today we reach another milestone – Wall World Demo is now available! 

And a lot has changed. 

[previewyoutube=DYHQezOlvh8;full][/previewyoutube]
We decided to rework how mining works – no longer you have to hit blocks with your body. Now you are equipped with a plasma drill, which also serves as a storage for the minerals you unearth. 

Enemy waves were rebalanced – now there are more enemies in each wave, but they have less HP. 

There is also a new big enemy. 

And we added several lore locations, which you can find while traversing the Wall. 

There are some other changes: 
[list][*] Now you can control your character with the mouse 
[*] Turret can also be controlled with the mouse 
[*] Added new animations and updated old ones 
[*] Added new backgrounds 
[*] Updated UI 
[*] Added new improvement: engine for a spider, which improves its speed by 10% [/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2187290

Hope to hear your feedback about new changes and improve the game even further. 

And, for now, corespeed! 

[url=https://discord.gg/xZXBfwAvPA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/be00d7c9135fba1255d1d702873a1c34667ed670.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Playtest 0.0.1.66 Update
notes.content:
We have released a small hotfix for Wall World. It includes some improvements to localization, changes to gameplay, and updates tutorial. 

Please, make sure that you have the latest (0.0.1.66) version of the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43153968/3f6c0807dc9b4d373f706de20807cee7e99573f5.png[/img]

[b]List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed resource drop frequency
[*] Changed how bounce works during mining
[*] Increased character’s movement speed
[*] Increased time between waves of enemies
[*] Remapped controls: "R" now attaches/detaches the spider to/from Wall, "E" connects the character to the spider, "Q" disconnects, and "F" opens the talent menu
[*] Updated tutorial to be in sync with control changes
[*] Rebalanced some upgrades and their costs
[*] Improved English, Chinese, and Russian localizations based on LQA feedback[/list]
